Reconciles API tokens (~0.75 words/tok) in a16z's USD 2.25/query example (100k in + 10k out tokens -> USD 9,450/yr at 4,200 queries/yr) and contrasts +21% to +55.8% developer RCT speedups with METR's -19% slowdown.
